scenarios.name: Retain Watch audio only with consent
scenarios.given: a Watch recording arrives on iPhone
scenarios.when: transcription finishes with Save audio recordings on or off
scenarios.then: opt-in retains playable audio and opt-out removes the inbox copy

manual.reason: Paired-device capture and reconnection need a real Watch and iPhone; simulator acceptance is separate.
steps: With retention enabled, record while disconnected and reconnect; verify the recording transfers once and plays on iPhone.
Repeat with retention disabled and verify transcription without retained playback audio.

Keep physical Watch capture, reconnection, battery/storage and production App Store acceptance pending; an authorized, validated TestFlight beta may distribute with these limits stated under AGENTS.md.

scenarios.name: Queue finalized chunks once
scenarios.given: a Watch recording contains finalized and active chunks
scenarios.then: only finalized chunks not already queued are selected, activation replay does not duplicate a pending transfer, and deleting waiting audio prevents a later retry

scenarios.name: Ignore duplicate Watch delivery
scenarios.given: a chunk has already been accepted on iPhone

scenarios.name: Reject remote start while phone is inactive
scenarios.given: the iPhone app is not active
scenarios.when: the Watch requests a remote start

scenarios.name: Preserve audio if crash recovery cannot queue it
scenarios.given: a Watch recording survived an interrupted launch and the outbox cannot be written
scenarios.when: the app tries recovery and later relaunches after storage is writable
scenarios.then: the original readable audio and metadata survive the failure, queue once after recovery, remain readable across relaunch, and are removed only by explicit Delete; multi-part recovery preserves later chunks and the original recording end boundary; if the end marker cannot be written, relaunch retries the original end even after audio moved

scenarios.name: Retain unacknowledged audio across failed transfer and relaunch
scenarios.given: a completed Watch recording has been queued
scenarios.when: its transfer fails and the app relaunches before a success callback
scenarios.then: the audio remains byte-identical and pending until success, and a duplicate success callback has no effect

scenarios.name: Cancel stale Watch microphone preparation
scenarios.given: a supported Watch recorder is about to request or is waiting for microphone permission
scenarios.when: the caller cancels, the user stops, or recording readiness becomes unavailable before permission returns
scenarios.then: no audio session or capture starts and no recording folder is created

scenarios.name: Finalize audio and resume only explicitly after interruption
scenarios.given: a supported Watch recorder has begun a recording
scenarios.when: audio is interrupted and the interruption ends, then the user continues and stops
scenarios.then: the first audio remains queued, capture waits for explicit Continue, the same recording advances its chunk index, and Stop finalizes readable AAC and returns to idle

scenarios.name: Keep audio if its durable metadata cannot be written
scenarios.given: a completed Watch audio chunk is ready while its outbox metadata path is unwritable
scenarios.when: the recorder hands it over and later retries after storage is repaired
scenarios.then: the failed handoff leaves original audio intact, and a successful retry keeps matching durable metadata across relaunch

scenarios.name: Do not overwrite unacknowledged Watch audio
scenarios.given: a chunk is already queued and has not been acknowledged
scenarios.when: its completed handoff repeats or a conflicting file uses the same identity
scenarios.then: an identical completed handoff has no effect and a conflict is rejected while both audio copies remain intact

scenarios.name: Show and erase recovery audio that could not enter the outbox
scenarios.given: a previous Watch recording remains in recovery because its handoff failed
scenarios.when: waiting recordings are shown and the user chooses Delete
scenarios.then: the unqueued recording is counted as waiting and Delete removes its recovery audio and end intent so it cannot return after repair and relaunch

scenarios.name: Keep the final recording boundary without a final audio chunk
scenarios.given: a Watch recording ends without a final audio chunk while transport is inactive and its outbox path is unwritable
scenarios.when: the end event is saved and the app later relaunches after storage repair
scenarios.then: the end remains visibly pending and its original final index and interruption state are recovered even without remaining source audio; successful activation queues the end once and clears an empty recovery intent without relaunch; later continued chunks advance a stale earlier end boundary and are marked unexpected after a crash; a completed continued handoff clears obsolete recovery intent after acknowledgement

scenarios.name: Keep failed live handoffs visible and protect active recording from Delete
scenarios.given: a Watch recording is active and a closed chunk cannot enter its outbox
scenarios.when: Delete is requested during capture and again after Stop
scenarios.then: the failed audio is visibly pending, active recording data is protected, and after Stop pending source audio is erased and cannot reappear after storage repair and relaunch

scenarios.name: Own foreground preparation and ignore late view callbacks
scenarios.given: Start or Continue is waiting for permission in the foreground
scenarios.when: the app backgrounds or the preparing view is dismissed and the user returns or retries
scenarios.then: pending UI preparation is cancelled, late grants or denials cannot start audio or alter a newer attempt, transient inactive permission UI remains allowed, and established recording is preserved for wrist-down operation; cancellation, supersession or owner release before the first task turn must not invoke permission work

scenarios.name: Decode received AAC for optional analysis without crashing on phone
scenarios.given: a received Watch AAC recording is ready for local language detection and speaker analysis
scenarios.when: the foreground phone decodes it to mono floating point samples, or decoding is cancelled or the file is unreadable
scenarios.then: bounded nonempty samples and recording-relative speaker windows are returned without creating Speech analyzer inputs; unreadable input reports failure and cancellation stops analysis without consuming source audio

manual.reason: iOS simulator Speech input handling differs from physical iPhone; use isolated physical test host for this crash regression. Paired Watch transfer is a separate acceptance.
steps: Decode checked-in synthetic AAC through production language and speaker readers on physical iPhone; preserve source and raw test results.
On beta, open the phone with a finished Watch recording pending and verify History import without a crash.

scenarios.name: Presentation dismissal does not act as Stop
scenarios.given: Watch microphone capture has started and the recording screen is presented
scenarios.when: the system dismisses the presentation while capture is active and the user later explicitly stops
scenarios.then: capture stays running with no finalized audio or end event at presentation dismissal; explicit Stop finalizes readable audio once and returns to idle

manual.reason: A simulator presentation callback cannot prove physical wrist-down audio execution.
steps: On a physical Watch start recording, lower wrist, raise it and verify uninterrupted recording and usable Stop.
Verify an actual audio interruption still shows its reason and requires explicit Continue.
